title: Which glass has more water?
subtitle: Water is poured from a short glass into a tall one: tap the glass with more, then hear why young children choose the tall one, as Piaget found.
notes: Choose on the figure (two glass groups + 'Same' rect). After the pour the tall glass slides beside the wide one (move). Lint flags labels on the tall glass's ORIGINAL position (it ignores the move): false positives.
